title: javaTNT
description: javaTNT – Realistic TNT explosions with craters, just like vanilla Java, optimized for Paper servers.
body:
Vanilla TNT

This plugin makes TNT behave exactly like it does in Java Edition.
It recreates real block physics, explosion power, and crater shapes so TNT feels natural and consistent on modern Paper servers.

Features

Accurate TNT physics from Java

Proper crater formation

Natural block break patterns

Works with survival, creative and multiplayer

Lightweight and fast

Why use this?

Paper’s default TNT can sometimes feel different from pure vanilla.
This plugin fixes that so your server gets real Java-style explosions.
